title: Configures an app project for Azure Web App deployment

project.description: The name of the app project to be configured
project.x-prompt: What is the name of the app project?

name.description: The name of the Azure Web App.  Defaults to the project name.

srcPath.description: The path to the compressed file containing the deploy artifacts.  Defaults to `deploy/{project}.zip`

resourceGroup.description: Name of the resource group that contains the Web App.
resourceGroup.x-prompt: What is the name of the resource group that contains the Web App?

subscription.description: Name or ID of the Azure subscription that contains the Web App. Always passed, so the deploy never falls back to the CLI's default subscription.
subscription.x-prompt: What is the name or ID of the Azure subscription that contains the Web App?
